name: dev-flow
description: Drives a dev workflow end-to-end (feats or fixes) in 4 phases — plan, build, verify, ship: brainstorm → spec → plan → create GitHub issue → execute (TDD) → test → review → doc-fix → open PR → manual merge → close-out. Own brainstorm, plan, tdd, execute-tasks, test, review, doc-fix, open-pr, create-github-issue, commit, new-idea, document-structure, whats-new, and bootstrap skills plus /new-feature, /new-idea, and /bootstrap commands. Fully self-contained — no external plugin dependencies.
